name: print-social-poster-set-lavender-black-brush-frame
title: Lavender posters with black brush-stroke photo frames
whatItIs: Three near-identical lavender posters, each using a bold black brushstroke shape as an irregular frame for a placeholder photo, with a thin gold-outlined text box beneath.
whatItMeans: An expressive brush shape substitutes for a photo when none is available yet, so the template still feels art-directed and intentional rather than empty.
techniques: use a rough brush-stroke shape as an organic alternative to a rectangular photo frame
pair one expressive black element with one delicate thin-line gold accent for contrast
offer near-identical layout variants so a single template feels like a flexible system

vocabulary.definition: an irregular, painterly shape used in place of a geometric border to crop or contain an image
